_comment: The retention-block library: retrieval-practice primitives for RETENTION levels, ingested by scripts/generate_blocks.js --family retention. Same contract as lesson blocks — renderBlock(target, data), content-in-JSON — so a retention level is filled, never recoded. tag is the file name and registry key; interactive is the scope lock; bestFor is the learner fit the primitive was chosen for.

blocks.title: Uncued Reconstruct
blocks.description: Word bank slots, formula fill, or scrambled clause assembly - the learner rebuilds the answer from scratch with no cues.
blocks.bestFor: Verbal/syntactic learners; low working memory load

blocks.title: Speed Categorizer
blocks.description: Rapid binary swipes or 3-way bucket sorting under a timer.

blocks.title: Misconception Trap
blocks.description: A choice among plausible, highly tempting flawed options - only one survives scrutiny.
blocks.bestFor: High-confidence learners who skim or pattern-match

blocks.title: Forensic Audit
blocks.description: Clickable code lines, essay paragraphs, or balance sheet rows where the learner hunts down the error.

blocks.title: Interleaved Matrix
blocks.description: Cross-topic comparative grids mixing past units, filled in cell by cell.

blocks.title: Far Transfer Workbench
blocks.description: An unfamiliar real-world scenario (medical, aerospace, legal, business) that the learner solves by applying the rule.

blocks.title: Reverse Syllogism
blocks.description: Given a conclusion or an error, select the missing false premise.

blocks.title: Dial Calibrator
blocks.description: A dial the learner tunes to bring variables into safe tolerance zones.
